title: Cat at the rainy window
idea: a tabby cat watches rain on a window, then turns to the camera
style: soft, warm, slightly desaturated, 35mm film grain
subject: a grey tabby cat with green eyes, fur slightly backlit
setting: a window sill in a quiet apartment on a rainy afternoon, raindrops running down the glass
light: soft overcast daylight through the window as key, warm lamp fill from inside the room

beats.action: the cat sits on the sill watching raindrops run down the glass, tail curled
beats.camera: locked-off, medium shot from inside the room

beats.action: its ear twitches; it turns its head slowly towards the camera
it blinks once and holds the look

physics: fur ripples slightly as the head turns; the tail settles after a small flick; raindrops merge and run at real speed

sound.ambience: rain tapping on glass, quiet room tone
